messages:
maya: Quick check — PR up to switch payments cluster to SecretOwnerBinding ownerRefs. Can someone sanity-check RBAC/TF before I roll? I think external-secrets controller needs secrets:patch + ownerReference create perms.
lee: Which PR? pinging infra team — link?
maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/472 — small TF + helm values change, mostly adding a role rule and an annotation.
nora: I skimmed it. Main changes: enable ownerBinding in the helm values and add a k8s role with verbs [get,list,watch,patch,update,create] on secrets. Make sure the ServiceAccount used by the controller is bound to that RoleBinding.
sam: Quick question — will existing secrets be picked up if they don't already have ownerReferences? and does rotation continue to work after we add ownerRefs?
maya: Short answer: external-secrets reconciles by spec/labels, so rotation still runs. But ownerRefs are used for GC and for operator bookkeeping. We should add ownerRefs to existing secrets before flipping any GC or lifecycle flags.
maya: TF snippet I added:```hcl
resource "kubernetes_role" "extsecret_controller" {
  metadata {
    name = "external-secrets-controller"
    namespace = "payments"
  }
  rule {
    api_groups = [""]
    resources  = ["secrets"]
    verbs      = ["get","list","watch","patch","update","create"]
  }
}
```
maya: k8s manifest example for ownerRef we will set:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: payment-tokens
  namespace: payments
  labels:
    app: payments
  ownerReferences:
  - apiVersion: external-secrets.redwood/v1
    kind: SecretOwnerBinding
    name: payment-binding
```
joel: heads up — ownerReferences can be tricky when added later. They're not strictly immutable at API level but some controllers expect them at create time. I suggest a one-off reconcile job to patch existing secrets rather than relying on the controller to mutate them in-place.
nora: Agreed. Plan: 1) add role/rolebinding in TF, 2) deploy to staging with ownerBinding=true in helm, 3) run a k8s job that patches existing secrets with ownerRefs for matching label selector, 4) monitor rotation/GC for 24h.
sam: Command we'd run for the job (approx):```bash
kubectl get secrets -n payments -l app=payments -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name}' | xargs -I{} kubectl patch secret {} -n payments --patch '{"metadata":{"ownerReferences":[{"apiVersion":"external-secrets.redwood/v1","kind":"SecretOwnerBinding","name":"payment-binding"}]}}'
```
lee: Note for TF: use `kubernetes_role` + `kubernetes_role_binding` referencing the existing svcacct. I'll add the `patch` verb to the clusterrole and push a small follow-up. Also we need to ensure the helm chart doesn't set ownerBinding:deleteOnRemove=true by default — that would GC secrets on uninstall.
maya: Good catch — I set deleteOnRemove=false in values, will add comment in PR.
sam: For safety, do a canary: enable in staging only for 2 hours, check `kubectl get secret -n payments -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{" -> "}{.metadata.ownerReferences[*].name}{"
"}{end}'` to confirm ownerRefs applied and rotations still happening.
joel: I'll help with the patch job; can run in staging and prod once you say go.
deploy-bot: PR merged to staging — deploy/helm payments-external-secrets v1.2.3 :rocket:
lee: I'll open the follow-up TF PR to add `patch` on the clusterrole and link it here.
maya: Thanks everyone — I'll run the canary tonight and post results. :thumbsup:
